## About
Shane and Ashlee Wilson started Blackstone after years of hands-on work in the trade. Shane went to school for his heating, ventilation and air conditioning degree, and Ashlee came from the hospitality side of customer care. They knew their neighbors deserved an HVAC business they could trust.
Shane is our lead tech, Justin Wilson is a tech, and Ashlee runs administration. We install, repair and maintain AC and heating systems, and we handle plumbing too. We work on the brands we install and on the ones we don't.
We believe in transparency and being upfront with you, from pricing to equipment. Our customers have given us a 4.8 rating from 163 Google reviews.

## Services
- Installation & Replacement: New heating and cooling systems, installed the right way and sized for your home or business.
- AC Repair: Prompt, effective repair for your air conditioning, heating and indoor air quality.
- Furnace Replacement: Replacement of all types of furnaces, matched to your home or business.
- Furnace Repair: Diagnosis and repair for all types of furnaces, for those chilly desert nights.
- Maintenance Plans: A membership that keeps your system on a regular schedule of tune-ups. Ask us about our special offer.
- Plumbing: Plumbing work for your home. A reviewer recommends us for any HVAC or plumbing issue.

## FAQ
Q: What areas do you serve?
A: Sun City, Surprise, Peoria, Glendale, El Mirage, Phoenix, Avondale, Goodyear, Litchfield Park, Tolleson, Anthem, New River, Cave Creek, Carefree, Scottsdale, Paradise Valley, Tempe, Mesa, Chandler, Gilbert and the surrounding areas.

Q: How often should my system be serviced?
A: We recommend twice a year, once before the heating season and once before the cooling season.

Q: Do you work on brands you don't install?
A: Yes. We specialize in select brands, but we're not limited to those.

Q: Do you offer financing?
A: Yes, we do. Contact us and we'll go over the options.
